ref: University Physics 3 §7.4 The Quantum Particle in a Box
excerpt: Energy quantization is a consequence of the boundary conditions.

reviewedMappings.2015-3-09:0: Source derives k=nπ/L and En=n²π²hbar²/(2mL²) for zero interior potential and infinite walls, with n=1 ground state. Original explicitly doubles mass and width and retains nonrelativistic model. Independent substitution yields 1/(2*2²)=1/8. Each option assessed against this ratio; no definite signed momentum assigned to stationary standing-wave state.
